_about: Characters by class (rows, in 'classes' order) and race (columns, in 'races' order) from Raider.IO's WoW Forever population census (https://forever.raider.io/population): characters Raider.IO tracks, levels 10 to 60. counts60: the same at level 60 only. prev: the counts at the end of the week before last (at least 7 days old) per level (all, 60) and key: classes, races, and classes within each faction (alliance, horde), from Raider.IO's weekly history, for the rising / falling arrows. levels: per key, [characters, at level 60, median level] (both factions). Keys: a region (all, us, eu, kr, tw), or region|ruleset. Shown on the Population Census page (/census) by census.py.
